MCL Series: A La Carte and Accessory Digital Dresser Gauges


From DD Sale

Dakota Digital now offers individual digital gauges for your 1996-2013 Harley Davidson Dresser or Bagger. These gauges are the same gauges you can buy in kit form: MCL-3000-OT/MCL-3000-R or MCL-3006-OT/MCL-3006-R. In addition Dakota Digital offers auxiliary gauges for Air Pressure, Boost and Ambient Air Temp allowing you to select the gauges that you want for your bike/ or replace individual gauges while keeping your other factory gauges. Available in either Blue or Red displays.

*When ordering a full Dakota Digital replacement 6 gauge kit you can add up to 1 additional gauge to the package for a total of 7 gauges.

Limited availability, listed colors are remaining stock.
